category_title: Students with learning difficulties and speech needs who engage through collaborative play and leadership roles
scenario_title: Initial introduction to Shakespearean text and fear of judgment
minimal_context: The student is reading a scene from A Midsummer Night's Dream and preparing to act it out in front of the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at your copy of A Midsummer Night's Dream. We are going to read the text and then perform the scene in front of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what these words mean. In the Mid summer night’s dream the text at first was quiet confusing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep reading and try your best. Who would like to volunteer to read the first character's lines?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Sometimes I feel comfortable because of the topic but sometimes I don’t like to raise my hand.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to move on to the drama activity now. Please stand up and perform your lines for the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. Some people judge you... I just don’t like performing in front of people.
